title: Middle of the Linked List
statement: Return the value sequence starting at the middle node. If there are two middle nodes, return the second one and everything after it.
hints: Counting the length and walking length // 2 steps is correct.
A fast pointer that moves two steps finds the middle when it reaches the end.
On an even length, two steps per one step lands on the later middle.
editorial: Move slow one step and fast two steps until fast cannot move two steps. Slow is then the middle required by the problem. Return the suffix that starts there.
